item.title: The Grid and the Brain Share One Criticality
item.description: Blackout and seizure prediction are the same mathematical problem. This is the strongest evidence that criticality is a universal organising principle of complex systems.
item.content:encoded: 780-line deep dive: grid criticality, neural avalanches, self-organised criticality, and the shared mathematics of blackout and seizure prediction.
